AI.motivation: 分数量子霍尔效应中的边缘态是理解拓扑物态的重要窗口，但此前缺乏对其选择性光学探测的手段。同时，复合费米子有效质量完全由电子-电子相互作用产生，需要直接的实验探针来测量这一相互作用诱导的质量。
AI.method: 利用复合费米子平均场框架，将强关联的分数量子霍尔问题映射为有效的整数量子霍尔问题，计算Jain序列各填充分数下包含体态和边缘态的吸光度谱。通过边缘态的光学跃迁分析，识别反转对称性破缺导致的原本禁止的跃迁激活及二阶非线性过程。
AI.result: CF边缘态吸收峰出现在60-500 GHz（B=10T, GaAs），相对体态CF回旋频率发生蓝移，但远低于同磁场下整数量子霍尔回旋频率。每个吸收系列中可分辨峰的数量等于填充的Lambda（CF朗道）能级数，可用于指纹识别分数。边缘处反转对称性破缺激活了体态中禁止的光学跃迁，并允许电偶极近似下的二阶非线性过程。吸收谱的绝对频率标度由CF有效质量决定，该质量完全由电子-电子相互作用产生。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明亚太赫兹光学光谱可作为选择性探测分数量子霍尔边缘态的敏感工具，其吸收谱提供了分数填充的指纹识别手段，并开辟了直接光学测量相互作用诱导的复合费米子有效质量的新途径，同时也预示了边缘态中新的非线性光学现象。

title: Interlayer-engineering of Charge Order Wave Vector in Kagome Metals
summary: Charge orders in the kagome metals AV$_3$Sb$_5$ sit at the center of a rich phase diagram that also includes superconductivity, nematicity, and signatures of time-reversal-symmetry breaking. Yet even the basic question of which charge ordering wave vectors are intrinsic, and which are selected by dimensionality and lattice coupling, remains unsettled. Importantly, the microscopic origin of different charge orders and, in particular, the relationship between the robust bulk $2 \times 2$ charge order and the controversial $4 \times 1$ modulation, which is primarily resolved by surface probes, remains unresolved. Here, we use first-principles calculations to study the role of interlayer coupling in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ by tuning the interlayer separation from the monolayer limit to the bulk limit. In the monolayer AV$_3$Sb$_5$ (A = Rb, Cs), the phonon spectrum exhibits no instability at the M point; instead, the dominant lattice instability occurs at q = (1/4, 0, 0), consistent with a $4 \times 1$ modulation. As interlayer coupling increases in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, an M-point phonon progressively softens and becomes unstable already near c = 12.24 Å, evolving into the strong $2 \times 2$ instability characteristic of the bulk. These results identify interlayer coupling as a control parameter at a fixed stoichiometry that links competing $4 \times 1$ and $2 \times 2$ tendencies, providing a unified framework for understanding why multiple charge-order wave vectors coexist and compete in kagome metals.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，研究了CsV₃Sb₅中层间耦合对电荷序的影响。研究发现单层时主导晶格不稳定性在q=(1/4,0,0)对应4×1调制，而随着层间耦合增强，M点声子逐渐软化并变得不稳定，最终演化为体相中强烈的2×2电荷序。这揭示了层间耦合是连接4×1和2×2竞争性电荷序的统一控制参数。
AI.motivation: Kagome金属AV₃Sb₅中电荷序与超导、向列性、时间反演对称性破缺等丰富的相图密切相关，但基本问题仍未解决：哪些电荷序波矢是内在的，哪些由维度性和晶格耦合决定。特别是体相中稳健的2×2电荷序与主要由表面探测到的4×1调制之间的微观起源关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用第一性原理计算，通过调节层间分离距离，系统地研究了CsV₃Sb₅从单层极限到体相极限的层间耦合作用，并分析声子谱的不稳定性随层间耦合的变化。
AI.result: 单层AV₃Sb₅（A=Rb, Cs）的声子谱在M点无失稳，主导晶格不稳定性出现在q=(1/4,0,0)，对应4×1调制。随着CsV₃Sb₅层间耦合增强，M点声子逐渐软化，在c≈12.24Å时变得不稳定，演化为体相中强烈的2×2不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 层间耦合是固定化学计量比下连接竞争性4×1和2×2电荷序的控制参数，为理解kagome金属中多种电荷序波矢共存与竞争提供了统一框架。

title: Atomic investigations on the mechanical properties of CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy nanowires
summary: This work investigated the mechanical properties of CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy (MEA) nanowires under uniaxial tensile loading along three crystallographic orientations [100], [110] and [111].The CoCrNi single crystal nanowires with face-centered cubic (FCC) structure exhibits a strong anisotropic behavior.Molecular dynamics simulations were employed to give atomic-level insight into the plastic deformation.The surface effect causes dislocations emitted from the free surface and slip into the internal. The temperature effect was also considered. Under identical geometric configurations, crystal orientations and temperature, interatomic interactions dominate key mechanical properties such as Young's modulus and yield strength.Simulation results reveal a promounced linear correlation between the average atomic force and mechanical performance across eight representative FCC metallic nanowires (Al, Au, Ag, Cu, Ni, Al19Mg alloy, FeCoCrCuNi high-entropy alloy and CoCrNi MEA). This study delivers novel insights into the mechanical behavior of metallic nanowires, and offers guidance for the rational design of alloy nanowires.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分子动力学模拟，系统研究了CoCrNi中熵合金纳米线在三种晶体取向（[100]、[110]、[111]）下的单轴拉伸力学性能，揭示了显著的各向异性行为，并发现八种代表性FCC金属纳米线的平均原子力与力学性能之间存在显著的线性相关性。
AI.motivation: 中熵合金纳米线具有优异的力学性能潜力，但其塑性变形机理和力学性能与晶体取向、温度及原子间相互作用的关系尚未被充分理解，需要原子层面的深入研究。
AI.method: 采用分子动力学（MD）模拟方法，对FCC结构的CoCrNi单晶纳米线沿[100]、[110]和[111]三个晶体取向进行单轴拉伸加载，同时考虑表面效应（位错从自由表面发射并向内部滑移）和温度效应，并对比八种FCC金属纳米线的平均原子力与力学性能关系。
AI.result: CoCrNi MEA纳米线表现出强烈的各向异性力学行为；表面效应导致位错从自由表面发射并滑入内部；在相同几何构型、晶体取向和温度下，原子间相互作用主导杨氏模量和屈服强度等关键力学性能；八种FCC金属纳米线的平均原子力与力学性能呈显著的线性相关。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为金属纳米线的力学行为提供了新见解，并为合金纳米线的理性设计提供了指导。

title: Occupation-Driven Josephson Diode in a Symmetric Junction
summary: We propose a Josephson diode mechanism in which nonreciprocity arises not from a conventional asymmetric Andreev spectrum but from nonequilibrium occupation of the current-carrying states engineered by attached reservoirs. We realize this mechanism in a double-quantum-dot junction, where a phase-textured nonlocal reservoir acts as a quantum Zeno selector: rapid dissipation freezes out the bright state directly coupled to the jump operator $L$, while preserving an orthogonal dark Andreev channel whose supercurrent remains comparable to that of the lossless junction. In the infinite-gap limit, the steady-state current factorizes as $I_{\rm ss}=I_A P_γ$, so that even when the Andreev current $I_A$ is strictly reciprocal, the phase asymmetry of $P_γ$ alone can produce a Josephson diode effect through reservoir engineering. We further show that local Coulomb repulsion can drive the system toward a nearly ideal diode regime via a dark-pair resonance. Using Keldysh-Lindblad calculations, we demonstrate that our results remain robust for realistic junctions with a finite superconducting gap and dissipation.

AI.tldr: 作者提出了一种全新的约瑟夫森二极管机制，其非互易性并非源于传统的非对称Andreev谱，而是由储库工程设计的非平衡占据态产生。该机制在双量子点结中实现，通过相位调制的非局域储库充当量子Zeno选择器，冻结与跳跃算子L直接耦合的亮态，同时保留正交的暗Andreev通道。在无限带隙极限下，稳态电流可分解为I_ss=I_A P_γ，即使Andreev电流I_A严格互易，P_γ的相位不对称性也能单独产生约瑟夫森二极管效应。局域库仑排斥可通过暗对共振将系统推向接近理想的二极管状态，且Keldysh-Lindblad计算表明，该结果在有限超导带隙和耗散的真实结中依然稳健。
AI.motivation: 传统的约瑟夫森二极管依赖于非对称Andreev谱，这通常难以实现或需要特殊材料条件。作者希望探索一种全新的物理机制，利用非平衡占据和量子Zeno效应来产生非互易超流，从而为约瑟夫森二极管提供更灵活、可工程化的设计思路。
AI.method: 作者采用双量子点结装置，其中相位调制的非局域储库扮演量子Zeno选择器角色，通过快速耗散来冻结亮态并保留暗Andreev通道。理论框架上采用Keldysh-Lindblad方法处理开放量子系统的稳态电流，并在无限带隙极限下推导出因子化形式I_ss=I_A P_γ，同时考虑局域库仑排斥对系统的影响。
AI.result: 在无限带隙极限下，稳态电流因子化为Andreev电流与相位相关因子P_γ的乘积，即使Andreev电流严格互易，P_γ的相位不对称性也能单独驱动约瑟夫森二极管效应；局域库仑排斥可通过暗对共振将系统推向接近理想的二极管状态；Keldysh-Lindblad计算证明该机制在有限超导带隙和耗散条件下依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了通过储库工程（而非谱工程）实现约瑟夫森二极管效应的全新途径，为超导量子器件的非互易输运提供了新的设计自由度，拓展了约瑟夫森二极管物理的实现机制。

title: Long-time Dynamics of Many-body Open Quantum Systems using Quantum Generating Functions
summary: The interplay between coherent unitary evolution and environment-induced dissipation can give rise to a wide range of non-equilibrium dynamics in open quantum systems, ranging from interesting transport phenomena to dynamical phase transitions. However, accessing such long-time dynamics remains challenging for the existing methods developed for the simulation of many-body open quantum systems. We address this problem by developing a quantum generating function (QGF) formalism for open many-body systems for both ensemble-averaged dynamics governed by a Markovian quantum master equation and trajectory-resolved dynamics described by the quantum trajectory formalism, including quantum jumps, and quantum state diffusion. Our approach computes the dynamics of higher-order moments and fluctuation statistics without explicitly evolving the quantum state, thereby providing an efficient and scalable approach for investigating many-body open quantum systems. We demonstrate the versatility of the formalism by applying it to both the integrable open XXZ chain and the nonintegrable open next-nearest-neighbor XXZ spin chain, where it uncovers distinct initial state dependent long-time transport regimes. Our work establishes quantum generating functions as an efficient and scalable framework for investigating long-time dynamics in open quantum many-body systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种量子生成函数（QGF）形式体系，用于高效模拟开放多体量子系统的长时间动力学。该方法无需显式演化量子态，即可计算高阶矩和涨落统计，适用于马尔可夫量子主方程描述的系综平均动力学以及量子轨迹形式（包括量子跳跃和量子态扩散）描述的轨迹分辨动力学。作者将该框架应用于开放XXZ链和开放次近邻XXZ自旋链，发现了依赖于初始态的长时间输运区。
AI.motivation: 开放量子系统中相干幺正演化与环境诱导耗散之间的相互作用可产生丰富的非平衡动力学现象（如输运现象和动力学相变），但现有方法在模拟多体开放量子系统的长时间动力学方面面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 发展了量子生成函数（QGF）形式体系，适用于两种动力学：1）由马尔可夫量子主方程控制的系综平均动力学；2）由量子轨迹形式描述的轨迹分辨动力学（包括量子跳跃和量子态扩散）。核心思路是不显式演化量子态，而是直接计算高阶矩和涨落统计量。
AI.result: 将该形式体系应用于可积的开放XXZ链和不可积的开放次近邻XXZ自旋链，发现并揭示了依赖于初始态的不同长时间输运区域，证明了该方法的多功能性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 量子生成函数被确立为一种高效且可扩展的框架，用于研究开放量子多体系统中的长时间动力学问题。

title: 3D- (H-theta-phi) magnetic phase diagram of antiferromagnetic metal GdB6 with electron and lattice instability
summary: The origin of charge transport and magnetization anisotropy was studied in GdB6, an antiferromagnetic (AF) metal (Néel temperature TN ~ 15.5 K) with cubic lattice and Gd S-type magnetic ions. Both small static Jahn-Teller distortions and nanoscale electronic instabilities (dynamic charge stripes) were found in precise low temperature X-ray diffraction measurements. The detailed magnetic field (H) vs temperature (T) phase diagrams were constructed with two main magnetic phases AF(I) and AF(II). Using the angular phi-dependences of magnetoresistance and magnetization, impeller-type patterns of the H-phi magnetic phase diagrams in the (110) and (111) planes were found at helium temperatures, which included the AF phases I and II separated from each other by radial and circular boundaries. The results argue in favor of the important role of the spin density wave 5d- component in the magnetic structure of AF(II) state. Charge fluctuations in stripes are proposed to be responsible for the suppression of the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yoshida (RKKY) indirect exchange between the first and second neighboring Gd3+ ions located along the <100> and <110> directions. These dynamic charge stripes and vibrationally coupled Gd-Gd pairs produce unusual anisotropy of charge scattering and the impeller-type diagrams in GdB6 with S-type magnetic ion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了立方晶格反铁磁金属GdB6（奈尔温度~15.5K）中电荷输运与磁化各向异性的起源。通过低温X射线衍射发现静态Jahn-Teller畸变和动态电荷条纹（纳米尺度电子不稳定性）。构建了磁场-温度相图，包含两个主磁相AF(I)和AF(II)，在氦温度下(110)和(111)面观测到叶轮状H-phi磁相图。结果表明自旋密度波5d分量在AF(II)态磁结构中起重要作用，电荷条纹的涨落抑制了沿<100>和<110>方向Gd3+离子间的RKKY间接交换，从而产生异常的各向异性。
AI.motivation: 理解GdB6这类具有S型磁性离子和立方晶格的简单反铁磁金属中，电荷输运和磁化各向异性的微观起源，特别是其异常各向异性行为的机制。
AI.method: 采用精密低温X射线衍射测量探测晶格畸变和电子不稳定性；通过磁阻和磁化强度的角向phi依赖关系构建磁场-温度相图和H-phi磁相图（分别在(110)和(111)平面）。
AI.result: 发现了静态Jahn-Teller畸变和动态电荷条纹共存；确定了AF(I)和AF(II)两个主要磁相；在氦温度下观测到由径向和圆形边界分隔的叶轮状磁相图模式；AF(II)态包含自旋密度波5d分量。
AI.conclusion: 动态电荷条纹抑制了沿<100>和<110>方向的RKKY间接交换，这些电荷条纹与振动耦合的Gd-Gd对共同产生了GdB6中S型磁性离子的异常电荷散射各向异性和叶轮状相图。

title: A solid-solution approach for room-temperature bulk plasticity in KTa1-xNbxO3
summary: Dislocations are being engineered into perovskite oxides to harvest versatile functional properties. One major bottleneck, however, persists: perovskite oxides that can be engineered with dislocations, particularly via mechanical deformation at room temperature in bulk scale, have so far been limited to only three materials: SrTiO3 (2001, Brunner et al.), KNbO3 (2016, Mark et al.), and KTaO3 (2024, Fang & Zhang et al.). Here, we propose a simple and effective approach by using solid solution to significantly extend the range of materials. We showcase KTa1-xNbxO3 (0<x<1) perovskite oxides for their bulk plasticity at room temperature by constructing a closed-loop validation workflow that includes crystal growth, Brinell indentation, bulk compression, and transmission electron microscopy characterization. Our findings are expected to unlock the materials toolbox for dislocation-tuned functionality of perovskite oxides.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用固溶体策略显著拓展可通过室温力学变形引入位错的钙钛矿氧化物材料范围。作者以KTa1-xNbxO3（0<x<1）为例，构建了包含晶体生长、布氏压痕、块体压缩和透射电子显微镜表征的闭环验证流程，成功展示了其室温块体塑性，有望为钙钛矿氧化物的位错调控功能化开辟更广阔的材料选择空间。
AI.motivation: 钙钛矿氧化物中位错工程可收获多种功能特性，但瓶颈在于目前仅三种材料（SrTiO3、KNbO3、KTaO3）能在室温下通过机械变形在块体尺度实现位错工程，材料种类极其有限，亟需拓展。
AI.method: 采用固溶体策略，将KNbO3与KTaO3形成连续固溶体KTa1-xNbxO3（0<x<1）；构建闭环验证工作流，包括晶体生长、布氏压痕实验、块体压缩实验及透射电子显微镜表征，全方位验证室温块体塑性。
AI.result: 成功展示了KTa1-xNbxO3（0<x<1）钙钛矿氧化物在室温下的块体塑性，验证了固溶体策略的有效性，显著扩展了可进行位错工程的材料范围。
AI.conclusion: 固溶体方法有望解锁钙钛矿氧化物位错调控功能化的材料工具箱，为更多钙钛矿氧化物实现位错工程提供通用且简便的途径。

title: Scalable, Simple, and Versatile Encapsulation of 2D Materials and Devices
summary: Air-sensitive 2D materials present a fundamental challenge for device integration. Encapsulation is often required to preserve intrinsic properties, yet conventional protection strategies often fail for thicker layers and complicate fabrication. Here, we demonstrate that electron-beam (e-beam) evaporated aluminum oxide ($\mathrm{AlO}_x$) serves as both an effective encapsulation layer and a platform for direct device fabrication. Unlike transfer-based approaches, this scalable method is compatible with thicker flakes and full device or wafer coverage. It requires no stacking procedures and enables contacts without post-encapsulation etching. Using rare-earth tritellurides ($\mathrm{RTe}_3$, R = La, Er), semimetallic $\mathrm{WTe}_2$, and superconducting $\mathrm{FeTe}_x\mathrm{Se}_{1-x}$, we show that $\mathrm{AlO}_x$ suppresses oxidation and preserves intrinsic optical and electronic properties. We establish substrate-dependent optimization of encapsulation across a range of flake thicknesses, demonstrate that ultrathin $\mathrm{AlO}_x$ preserves $\mathrm{WTe}_2$'s plasmonic response and maintains superconducting performance in $\mathrm{FeTe}_x\mathrm{Se}_{1-x}$. Thus we overcome the longstanding tradeoff between encapsulation and straightforward device fabrication in fragile quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文展示电子束蒸发的氧化铝（AlOx）可作为空气敏感二维材料的有效封装层和直接器件制造平台，克服了封装与器件制造之间的长期权衡。
AI.motivation: 空气敏感的二维材料在器件集成中面临根本性挑战，传统封装策略对较厚层失效且使制造过程复杂化，需要在封装保护和器件制造便捷性之间做出权衡。
AI.method: 采用电子束蒸发的AlOx作为封装层，该方法可扩展、与厚薄片兼容、可覆盖整个器件或晶圆，无需堆叠工序，也不需要封装后刻蚀即可实现接触。在RTe3、WTe2和FeTexSe1-x等多种材料上验证了其效果。
AI.result: AlOx能有效抑制氧化并保持材料的本征光学和电子性质。超薄AlOx层保持了WTe2的等离激元响应，并维持了FeTexSe1-x的超导性能。建立了基于衬底的封装优化方案，适用于不同厚度的薄片。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功克服了脆弱量子材料中封装保护与便捷器件制造之间的长期权衡，为空气敏感二维材料的器件集成提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。

title: Metallogenic quantum criticality: Fermi surface nucleation at transitions between gapped phases
summary: Continuous quantum phase transitions in interacting many-body systems exhibit universal phenomena that are largely independent of microscopic details. An organizing principle distilled from canonical examples such as the magnetic transition in Ising models is that the low-energy physics of transitions between gapped phases is governed by scale-invariant quantum field theories with gapless degrees of freedom at isolated points in momentum space. In this paper, we show that this principle can fail in a radical way: an entire gapless Fermi surface can emerge at a quantum critical point separating two fully gapped insulators. These exotic phase transitions are dubbed \textit{metallogenic quantum critical points} (MGQCP). We construct a controlled family of effective field theories for MGQCPs between distinct fractional Chern insulators and propose a periodically modulated quantum Hall bilayer as a minimal microscopic setting. The critical theory exhibits an unusual mixture of physical signatures: while transport and compressibility follow scaling laws compatible with a conformal field theory, the electron spectral function develops a power-law non-analyticity at the Fermi momentum, characteristic of non-Fermi-liquid metals. We discuss how the concept of MGQCP may shed new light on critical phenomena in moire materials with tunable Chern bands. More generally, our results point to a broader class of quantum critical phenomena in which extended manifolds of gapless excitations emerge in momentum space despite being absent in both neighboring phases.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一种全新的量子相变类型——"成金属量子临界点"(MGQCP)，其中两个完全有能隙的绝缘体之间的量子临界点上可以涌现出完整的无能隙费米面，这颠覆了传统认知中"相邻有能隙相之间的相变由孤立动量点的无能隙激发支配"的组织原则。
AI.motivation: 传统凝聚态物理认为，两个有能隙相之间的连续量子相变，其低能物理由孤立动量点处的无标度量子场论支配（如Ising模型中的磁性转变）。作者质疑这一原则是否在更广泛的系统中成立——是否可能在一个量子临界点上涌现出扩展的无能隙费米面。
AI.method: 作者构建了一族受控的有效场论来描述MGQCP，这些相变发生在不同的分数量子霍尔绝缘体之间。同时提出了一个最小化的微观物理实现：周期调制的量子霍尔双层系统。
AI.result: 临界理论展现出异乎寻常的混合物理特征：输运和压缩率遵循与共形场论兼容的标度律，但电子谱函数在费米动量处出现幂律非解析性——这是非费米液体金属的典型特征。这种"共形标度+非费米液体谱"的混合是前所未有的。此外，该概念可能为具有可调Chern带的moire材料中的临界现象提供新见解。
AI.conclusion: 作者指出存在一类更广泛的量子临界现象，其中扩展的动量空间无能隙激发流形可以在量子临界点涌现，尽管在相邻的两个物相中都不存在。这拓展了量子临界现象学的边界，揭示了量子临界性的一种新范式。

title: Observation of dodecagonal replica bands in 30$^{\circ}$-twisted bilayer WSe$_2$
summary: Twisted bilayers of two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenides are promising systems for achieving tunable quasicrystalline orders with emergent properties. The underpinning electronic structure and scattering processes in 2D quasicrystals with multiorbital dodecagonal replica bands have so far not been determined. Here, we utilize angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) with micrometer spatial resolution to directly observe replica bands in 30$^{\circ}$-twisted bilayer WSe$_2$. The symmetry and intensity distribution of the observed replicas are explained by interlayer Umklapp scattering from bottom to top WSe$_2$ layers. Our spectral function measurements are consistent with the presence of a van Hove singularity adjacent to the $\mathrm{K}$-valleys, which underlines the possibility of inducing electronic reconstructions in bilayers with a large interlayer twist angle.

AI.tldr: 本文利用微米级空间分辨率的角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）直接观测了30°扭转双层WSe₂中的复制能带，揭示了由层间Umklapp散射引起的电子结构及其与范霍夫奇点的关联。
AI.motivation: 二维过渡金属硫族化合物的扭转双层结构是实现可调准晶序的有前景体系，但其多轨道十二重复制能带背后的电子结构和散射过程此前尚未被确定。
AI.method: 采用具有微米空间分辨率的角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）技术，对30°扭转双层WSe₂进行直接测量，并通过层间Umklapp散射模型解释观测到的复制能带的对称性和强度分布。
AI.result: 成功直接观测到30°扭转双层WSe₂中的复制能带；复制能带的对称性和强度分布可由从底层到顶层WSe₂的层间Umklapp散射解释；谱函数测量与K谷附近范霍夫奇点的存在相一致。
AI.conclusion: 该发现表明在大层间扭转角双层体系中可能诱导电子重构，为二维准晶体系中实现可调电子性质提供了实验基础。

title: Multi-orbital physics in inverse Lieb lattice altermagnets
summary: The inverse Lieb lattice has recently emerged as a promising platform for altermagnetism, with several materials with this structure proposed as $d$-wave altermagnetic candidates. Here, we develop a symmetry-based microscopic Hamiltonian for these materials that includes both sublattice and orbital degrees of freedom, going beyond the sublattice-only minimal models that have been extensively used to study such altermagnets. We apply these models to examine multi-orbital electron correlation physics in the vanadium oxychalcogenide family altermagnets, which contain dominant $xy$ and $xz/yz$ orbitals character at the Fermi level in the altermagnetic state. We demonstrate that $xy$ orbitals are crucial to stabilize the altermagnetic state observed within a single V$_2$O layer, and altermagnetic order in the $xz/yz$ orbitals is induced through Hund's coupling. Additionally, we show that these multi-orbital models reveal topological regimes in which topological edge states are naturally orbital selective.

AI.tldr: 本文针对反Lieb晶格结构的d波交变磁材料，发展了包含子格和轨道自由度的对称性基微观哈密顿量，超越了仅含子格的简化模型，并将其应用于钒氧硫族化物家族交变磁体的多轨道电子关联物理研究。
AI.motivation: 已有的交变磁体研究多采用仅包含子格自由度的最小模型，忽略了轨道自由度，无法全面捕捉多轨道体系中轨道选择性效应和电子关联的关键物理。
AI.method: 基于对称性构建包含子格与轨道自由度的微观哈密顿量，应用于V₂O单层钒氧硫族化物交变磁体，分析Fermi面附近的xy和xz/yz轨道特征，并通过Hund耦合机制研究轨道间的磁有序耦合及拓扑性质。
AI.result: 发现xy轨道对稳定单层V₂O中的交变磁序至关重要，而xz/yz轨道的交变磁序是通过Hund耦合被诱导产生的；多轨道模型还揭示了轨道选择性的拓扑边缘态。
AI.conclusion: 多轨道模型揭示了轨道自由度在交变磁序稳定与拓扑性质中的关键作用，为理解钒氧硫族化物交变磁体提供了更完整的理论框架。

title: Instability of two-dimensional nonrelativistic altermagnets
summary: Altermagnets (AMs) are collinear compensated magnets that exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without requiring a net magnetization. Since local magnetic moments and exchange-driven order do not rely on relativistic effects, altermagnetism can be naturally formulated in a nonrelativistic spin-group framework. This raises a basic question: can two-dimensional altermagnetic order be stabilized by purely exchange interactions in the absence of spin-orbit-induced anisotropy? We address this question by applying Bogoliubov's inequality to a minimal $d$-wave altermagnetic spin model. We show that the anisotropic exchange pattern responsible for altermagnetism still contributes only a quadratic long-wavelength term to the Bogoliubov denominator. Consequently, short-ranged exchange interactions alone cannot stabilize long-range altermagnetic order in two dimensions when continuous spin-rotation symmetry is preserved. In contrast, the corresponding three-dimensional system has a finite small-momentum contribution and is not ruled out by the Mermin-Wagner argument.

AI.tldr: 本文通过应用Bogoliubov不等式研究二维交变磁（altermagnetic）序的稳定性。研究发现，在不存在自旋-轨道诱导各向异性的情况下，仅靠短程交换相互作用无法在二维系统中稳定长程交变磁序（体系保持连续自旋转对称性时），而三维系统则不受此限制。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体是一类具有动量依赖自旋劈裂的共线补偿磁体，不需要净磁化。由于交变磁性可以在非相对论自旋群框架下自然表述，一个基本问题由此产生：在缺乏自旋-轨道耦合诱导的各向异性纯交换相互作用下，二维交变磁序能否被稳定？
AI.method: 将一个Bogoliubov不等式应用于最小化的d波交变磁自旋模型，分析各向异性交换模式对Bogoliubov分母的贡献，并通过比较二维与三维系统的长波极限行为来判断长程磁序是否能被稳定。
AI.result: 研究表明，导致交变磁性的各向异性交换模式仅对Bogoliubov分母贡献一个二次长波项；因此，当连续自旋转对称性保持时，仅靠短程交换相互作用无法在二维中稳定长程交变磁序。相比之下，对应的三维系统具有有限的小动量贡献，不受Mermin-Wagner论证排除。
AI.conclusion: 二维交变磁长程有序无法仅由短程交换相互作用在无自旋轨道耦合各向异性的条件下稳定，需引入额外机制（如磁各向异性）来克服这一限制；三维交变磁系统则不受此影响。

title: Switchable giant room-temperature nonlinear Hall effect in Bilayer Graphene
summary: Utilizing quantum second-order nonlinear transport for practical junction-free devices require materials with large and tunable nonlinearites at room temperature -- a current materials platform challenge. Here, we report the nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE) in double-ionic gated bilayer graphene devices that enable unusually strong inversion breaking. We observe NLHE that are readily switchable (on, off, and sign reversed) with second order nonlinear susceptibilities $χ^{(2)}_{yxx}$ that reaches giant room-temperature values of $3\,10^{-3}\,μ\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{S/V}$, comparable to values commonly observed at low temperature in WTe$_2$ or in graphene-based moiré superlattices, and three-to-four orders of magnitude larger than values reported in material systems recently employed in search of a room-temperature NLHE. Our devices produce corresponding THz voltage responsivities $\simeq 4\,10^{4}\,\mathrm{V/W}$, comparable to commercially available Schottky diodes. These are orders of magnitude better than for previously reported room-temperature NLHE devices rendering double-ionic gated bilayer graphene a choice platform for junction-free nonlinear technology.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在双离子门控双层石墨烯器件中实现非线性霍尔效应(NLHE)，该效应可轻易切换（开、关、符号反转），其二阶非线性磁化率χ²在室温下达到3×10⁻³ μm·S/V的巨型值，与WTe₂或石墨烯莫尔超晶格在低温下观测的值相当，比此前报道的室温NLHE材料系统高出3-4个数量级。相应THz电压响应度约4×10⁴ V/W，可与商业肖特基二极管媲美，使双离子门控双层石墨烯成为无结非线性技术的首选平台。
AI.motivation: 利用量子二阶非线性输运实现实际无结器件，需要室温下具有大且可调非线性响应的材料平台，这是当前材料领域面临的挑战。寻找能够在室温下实现强且可切换非线性霍尔效应的材料系统是推动该技术走向实用的关键。
AI.method: 采用双离子门控双层石墨烯器件，通过双离子门控实现异常强的反演对称性破缺，从而产生非线性霍尔效应。实验中系统测量了NLHE信号的可切换性（开、关、符号反转），并提取了二阶非线性磁化率χ²及THz电压响应度等关键参数。
AI.result: 在室温下实现了χ²达3×10⁻³ μm·S/V的巨型二阶非线性响应，与WTe₂或石墨烯莫尔超晶格在低温下的值相当，比此前室温NLHE材料体系高出3-4个数量级；THz电压响应度约4×10⁴ V/W，与商业肖特基二极管相当，且远优于此前报道的室温NLHE器件。
AI.conclusion: 双离子门控双层石墨烯凭借其极强的反演对称性破缺能力和室温下超大且可调的非线性响应，被确立为无结非线性技术的优选材料平台，为实用化的量子非线性输运器件铺平了道路。

title: A continuous confinement-deconfinement transition in a triangular quantum magnet
summary: A continuous transition between phases hosting distinct excitations---bosonic magnons versus fermionic spinons---is a long-sought phenomenon in quantum magnetism, analogous to the confinement--deconfinement transition in quantum chromodynamics. We report evidence for such a transition in the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet TlYbS$_2$. Antiferromagnetic order develops below $T_\mathrm{N} \approx 0.53\,\mathrm{K}$. A $c$-axis field suppresses this order, driving the system into a gapless quantum spin liquid with a spinon Fermi surface above $μ_0 H_\mathrm{c} \approx 3\,\mathrm{T}$, evidenced by a finite residual linear term in thermal conductivity, a Pauli-like susceptibility, and a temperature-independent NMR Knight shift. Approaching $H_\mathrm{c}$ from above, the scattering rate of itinerant excitations is strongly enhanced while their density of states shows no critical enhancement, atypical of conventional magnetic quantum criticality. These results point to a continuous confinement--deconfinement transition governed by fractionalized excitations beyond the Ginzburg--Landau paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了三角晶格反铁磁体TlYbS₂中从玻色子磁振子到费米子自旋子的连续相变证据。c轴磁场抑制反铁磁序后，系统进入具有自旋子费米面的无隙量子自旋液体态，表现出有限残余线性热导、泡利型磁化率和温度无关的NMR Knight位移。这为超越Ginzburg-Landau范式的禁闭-去禁闭相变提供了实验支持。
AI.motivation: 在量子磁性领域中，寻找一个连接不同激发（玻色子磁振子与费米子自旋子）的连续相变长期被认为是重要的目标，这类似于量子色动力学中的禁闭-去禁闭转变。作者旨在通过实验寻找并证实这种超越传统Ginzburg-Landau范式的新型相变。
AI.method: 研究采用多种互补的宏观与微观探测手段：通过热导率测量检测残余线性项（识别无隙激发）、磁化率测量观察泡利型行为、NMR Knight位移测量确认温度无关特性，并结合临界场附近散射率与态密度的对比分析来刻画临界行为。
AI.result: 发现TlYbS₂在约0.53 K以下形成反铁磁序，c轴磁场在约3 T处抑制该序，体系进入具有自旋子费米面的无隙量子自旋液体态。从顺磁侧接近临界场时，巡游激发散射率显著增强而态密度无临界增强，这偏离传统磁性量子临界特征。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果指向一个由分数化激发主导的连续禁闭-去禁闭转变，其性质超越了Ginzburg-Landau理论框架，为研究量子磁性中的分数化量子临界现象提供了重要平台。

title: A review of simulation, measurement techniques, and development in chip thermal design
summary: As integrated circuits advance toward higher power densities, three-dimensional integration, and heterogeneous packaging, chip thermal management has become a key bottleneck limiting device performance, reliability, and lifetime. This article systematically reviews numerical simulation methods and experimental measurement techniques for chip thermal design, with particular emphasis on the technical challenges associated with multiscale and multiphysics coupling, thermal boundary resistance measurement, and high-heat-flux cooling. We first introduce macro- and device-scale thermal simulation methods, including equivalent thermal-circuit models, the finite element method, and computational fluid dynamics, and discuss the application of phonon transport theory and molecular dynamics at microscopic scales. We then examine the advantages and limitations of infrared thermography, thermoreflectance, Raman thermometry, and embedded sensors. Current limitations include the enormous computational cost, inaccurate multiscale coupling, expensive experimental facilities, and the physical limits of conventional cooling technologies. Finally, we discuss emerging directions, including AI-accelerated thermal simulation, embedded microchannel liquid cooling, two-phase cooling, advanced high-thermal-conductivity materials, and multiphysics co-design, with the aim of advancing chip thermal management toward greater efficiency and intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了芯片热设计中的数值模拟方法与实验测量技术，涵盖从宏观到微观的多尺度仿真方法（等效热路模型、有限元、CFD、声子输运与分子动力学）以及多种实验测量手段（红外热成像、热反射、拉曼测温、嵌入式传感器），指出了当前面临的计算成本、多尺度耦合、实验设施和冷却技术等瓶颈，并展望了AI加速仿真、嵌入式微通道液冷、两相冷却、高导热材料及多物理场协同设计等新兴方向。
AI.motivation: 随着集成电路向更高功率密度、三维集成和异构封装方向发展，芯片热管理已成为限制器件性能、可靠性和寿命的关键瓶颈，亟需对现有热设计与测量技术进行系统梳理。
AI.method: 论文采用文献综述方法，分别从数值模拟与实验测量两大技术维度展开：数值模拟涵盖宏观设备级（等效热路模型、有限元法、CFD）和微观尺度（声子输运理论、分子动力学）；实验测量涵盖红外热成像、热反射法、拉曼测温及嵌入式传感器。
AI.result: 文章指出当前技术的局限性包括：巨大的计算成本、多尺度耦合不准确、实验设施昂贵、传统冷却技术面临物理极限；同时提出AI加速热仿真、嵌入式微通道液冷、两相冷却、高导热材料和多物理场协同设计等新兴研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 芯片热管理正朝着更高效率和智能化方向发展，需要综合多尺度建模、先进测量技术与新兴冷却方案的协同创新来突破现有瓶颈。

title: Exceptional point induced by hyperbolicity in an electrostatic spherical shell
summary: Exceptional points (EPs) are non--Hermitian degeneracies at which both eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, usually engineered through balanced gain and loss or non--reciprocity. In this work, we show that the radial electrostatic problem of an anisotropic core--shell nanoparticle realizes an EP without any of the alluded conditons. Written in the logarithmic radial coordinate, the problem is a Cauchy--Euler equation that maps onto a damped oscillator and, equivalently, onto a two-site Hatano--Nelson Hamiltonian, so that the non-Hermiticity is emulated in space rather than in time and the sole control parameter is the degree of dielectric anisotropy, $\varepsilon_t/\varepsilon_r$. The shell is passive, reciprocal, and lossless, yet it hosts an EP and a non--Hermitian phase transition governed by hyperbolicity alone. Beyond a hyperbolicity threshold the electric field inside the shell turns from monotonic decay into spatial oscillation, producing hotspots at intermediate radii which can be exploited to tailor fluorescence, strong coupling, sensing, or cloaking. More broadly, this establishes hyperbolic media as a platform to simulate non--Hermitian physics without gain, loss, or non--reciprocity.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了各向异性核壳纳米粒子的径向静电问题可以实现奇异点（EP），无需增益、损耗或非互易性。通过对数径向坐标变换，该问题映射为阻尼振荡器和两格点Hatano-Nelson哈密顿量，非厄米性由各向异性介电常数比(εt/εr)在空间中模拟。壳层是被动、互易、无损耗的，却因双曲性展现出EP和非厄米相变，超越双曲性阈值后电场从单调衰减转为空间振荡，产生中间半径的热点，可用于荧光调控、强耦合、传感或隐身。这确立了双曲介质作为无需增益损耗或非互易性即可模拟非厄米物理的平台。
AI.motivation: 传统奇异点的实现通常需要平衡的增益与损耗或非互易性，这些条件在实验上具有挑战性。作者旨在寻找一种无需这些特殊条件的更简单机制来实现EP，并探索其在纳米光子学中的应用。
AI.method: 将各向异性核壳纳米粒子的径向静电问题用对数径向坐标表示为Cauchy-Euler方程，进而映射到阻尼振荡器和两格点Hatano-Nelson哈密顿量。非厄米性由介电各向异性比εt/εr作为唯一控制参数在空间而非时间中模拟，无需增益、损耗或非互易条件。
AI.result: 被动、互易、无损耗的壳层中实现了EP和非厄米相变，由双曲性单独控制。超过双曲性阈值后，壳内电场从单调衰减转为空间振荡，在中间半径产生热点，可用于调控荧光、强耦合、传感和隐身。
AI.conclusion: 双曲介质可作为一种平台，在无需增益、损耗或非互易性的条件下模拟非厄米物理，为在被动系统中研究奇异点物理开辟了新途径，并具有实际纳米光子学应用潜力。

title: Exact Stiffness and Dynamical Responses from Fock-Space Fragmentation
summary: Exactly solvable quantum many-body models are rare, and even when their spectra are algebraically organized, dynamical responses generally remain difficult to obtain because they probe an extensive number of excited states. Here we show that quantum geometric nesting (QGN) models admit an unusually strong form of solvability rooted in \emph{Fock-space fragmentation}: excitations on top of the exact frustration-free ground states decouple into Krylov subspaces with a fixed number of particle and hole operators, and hence remain dynamically invariant. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the stiffness of the spontaneously broken continuous symmetry in QGN models is exactly equal to its variational value in the Gaussian manifold, confirming a conjecture from quantum many-body bootstrap~\cite{GaoHanKhalaf2026}. The proof shows that an infinitesimal phase twist couples the ground state only to the one-particle, one-hole fragment, which coincides with the tangent space of the ground state within the variational manifold, thereby making the variational curvature exact. More generally, perturbations whose action remains within a fixed Fock-space fragment have response functions determined exactly by the corresponding few-body sector, enabling exact access to quantities including static susceptibility, optical conductivity, dynamical structure factors, and single-particle Green's functions.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一类量子几何嵌套（QGN）模型具有基于Fock空间碎裂化的强可解性：激发态在粒子-空穴算子数固定的Krylov子空间中动态不变，从而可以精确计算自发破缺连续对称性的刚度、静态磁化率、光导率、动力学结构因子和单粒子格林函数等响应函数。
AI.motivation: 精确可解的量子多体模型极为罕见，即使能谱具有代数结构，动力学响应仍然难以获得，因为它需要探测大量激发态。作者希望利用QGN模型的特殊结构来突破这一困难。
AI.method: 利用QGN模型的Fock空间碎裂化结构：在精确无挫折基态上的激发态被解耦为具有固定粒子数和空穴算子数的Krylov子空间，从而保持动力学不变性。通过证明无穷小相位扭转仅将基态耦合到单粒子-单空穴扇区（该扇区与变分流形中基态的切空间重合），使得变分曲率精确成立。
AI.result: 证明了QGN模型中自发破缺连续对称性的刚度精确等于高斯流形上的变分值，证实了量子多体bootstrap中的一个猜想。此外，对于作用保持在固定Fock空间碎片内的微扰，其响应函数可由对应的少体扇区精确确定。
AI.conclusion: QGN模型提供了一类极少见的精确可解多体系统，可精确访问包括静态磁化率、光导率、动力学结构因子和单粒子格林函数在内的多种动力学响应，为量子多体动力学研究提供了新的理论工具。

title: Self-selective growth of GaAs1-xBix on GaAs zinc blende/wurtzite nanowire heterostructures
summary: Site-selective nanostructure growth and material incorporation at the atomic scale offer a promising pathway for engineering quantum materials and nanodevices. Here, GaAs nanowires (NWs) with an axial heterostructure of alternating zinc blende (Zb) and wurtzite (Wz) crystal phases are employed as templates for site-selective Ga and Bi overgrowth. Using X-ray photoemission electron microscopy (XPEEM) with nanoscale spatial resolution, we map elemental distribution and local chemical bonding to reveal the incorporation behavior of Bi atoms in {110} Zb and {11-20} Wz facets. Bi incorporation proceeds through an anion-exchange process, where Bi atoms replace As, forming local Ga-Bi bonds and producing a thin GaAs1-xBix shell. We observe crystal-phase-dependent Bi incorporation, with higher Bi concentration in the Zb segments than in the neighboring Wz segments within the same NW. Furthermore, the Zb segment with higher Bi content exhibits reduced susceptibility to oxidation compared with the Wz segment, resulting in increased Ga-oxide in the Wz surfaces. This study highlights GaAs NW Zb/Wz heterostructures as a template for controlled growth of GaBi and GaAs1-xBix nanostructures with tailored functionalities for quantum applications

AI.tldr: 本研究利用GaAs纳米线中的闪锌矿(Zb)和纤锌矿(Wz)轴向异质结构作为模板，通过XPEEM纳米级空间分辨技术揭示了Bi原子在{110}Zb和{11-20}Wz晶面上的选择性掺入行为。研究发现Bi通过阴离子交换过程取代As形成Ga-Bi键和GaAs1-xBix薄壳层，且不同晶相中Bi掺入浓度存在差异（Zb段高于Wz段），同时高Bi含量的Zb段展现出更强的抗氧化性。
AI.motivation: 原子尺度的位点选择性纳米结构生长和材料掺入为工程化量子材料和纳米器件提供了有前景的途径，理解Bi在GaAs纳米线不同晶相表面的选择性掺入机制对于可控生长量子功能材料至关重要。
AI.method: 以具有轴向Zb/Wz交替晶相异质结构的GaAs纳米线为模板，进行Ga和Bi的选择性过生长，并利用具有纳米级空间分辨率的X射线光电子发射电子显微镜(XPEEM)来绘制元素分布和局部化学键合信息。
AI.result: Bi掺入通过阴离子交换过程进行（Bi取代As形成Ga-Bi键和GaAs1-xBix薄壳层）；观察到晶相依赖的Bi掺入特性，同一纳米线中Zb段的Bi浓度高于相邻Wz段；高Bi含量的Zb段比Wz段具有更低的氧化敏感性，而Wz表面则产生更多Ga氧化物。
AI.conclusion: GaAs纳米线Zb/Wz异质结构可作为可控生长GaBi和GaAs1-xBix纳米结构的模板，为具有定制功能的量子应用提供了新的材料工程策略。

title: Hall effect in viscous flows of two-dimensional electrons in samples with edges of arbitrary roughness
summary: In ultra-clean conductors, fast inter-particle collisions can lead to the formation of a viscous electron fluid and realization of the hydrodynamic transport regime. Here we develop a theory of hydrodynamic magnetotransport of two-dimensional (2D) electrons in samples with low densities of defects and edges of arbitrary roughness. Within our model the roughness is described by a single parameter with the dimension of speed in the boundary conditions on sample edges. The electron-fluid flow profiles in long samples, as well as the corresponding longitudinal and Hall resistances, are calculated. The contribution to the Hall resistance associated with the relaxation processes exhibits a saturation in the limit of high magnetic field and a minimum as a function of the magnetic field for sufficiently rough edges. The minimum disappears as the edge roughness decreases or the sample width and bulk scattering by defects increase. These properties of the Hall resistance can serve as the signs to identify the hydrodynamic regime of electron transport in experiments and can be used to determine its parameters, in particular, the degree of edge roughness.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了二维超净导体中电子流体动力学磁输运理论，通过单一速度参数描述边缘粗糙度，计算了长样品中的电子流体流动轮廓及纵向和霍尔电阻。研究发现霍尔电阻中与弛豫过程相关的贡献在高磁场下饱和，并在边缘足够粗糙时随磁场出现最小值，该最小值随边缘粗糙度减小或样品宽度及体散射增加而消失，可作为识别电子流体动力学输运实验的标志。
AI.motivation: 在超净导体中，快速的粒子间碰撞可导致粘性电子流体形成，实现流体动力学输运机制。此前缺乏对具有任意粗糙边缘的二维电子系统的流体动力学磁输运理论，需要建立模型来理解边缘粗糙度对输运性质的影响，以便在实验中识别该输运机制。
AI.method: 作者发展了一个二维电子流体动力学磁输运理论，通过一个具有速度量纲的单一参数在样品边缘边界条件中描述边缘粗糙度，基于该模型计算了长样品中的电子流体流动轮廓以及相应的纵向电阻和霍尔电阻。
AI.result: 霍尔电阻中与弛豫过程相关的贡献在高磁场极限下表现出饱和现象，并且在边缘足够粗糙时随磁场呈现最小值。该最小值在边缘粗糙度减小或样品宽度、体缺陷散射增加时消失。
AI.conclusion: 霍尔电阻的这些特性可作为实验识别电子流体动力学输运机制的特征标志，并可用于确定输运参数，尤其是边缘粗糙度的程度。

title: Repeated Growth and Hot Delamination of Single-Crystal Graphene: A Two-Kilometer Process-Design Assessment with hBN as a Separate Case
comment: 36 pages, 7 figures, including Supporting Information. Invited Perspective submitted to Advanced Materials
summary: Large single crystals of graphene and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) remain difficult to manufacture because batch growth and transfer limit area, throughput, and quality. This Perspective asks whether an atomically thin film could instead be grown, hot-delaminated, and regrown repeatedly on a long, reusable single-crystal metal surface. No integrated process is demonstrated. Once rapid full-area growth is available, hot film removal is likely to become the rate-limiting step, whereas usable single-crystal growth area sets the material produced per cycle. Two experiments determine whether the concept merits further development: rapid, damage-free delamination at or near the growth temperature, and acceptable film growth through repeated complete growth-dwell-peel-regrowth cycles. The analysis then examines the crystalline growth surface, layer control, interface and gas chemistries, product capture, quality criteria, energy, and scale. These provisional analyses expose known requirements, define early stop criteria, and guide experiments; they cannot anticipate every coupled constraint or failure mode. Graphene is the quantitative baseline. hBN requires its own M(111), product thickness, apparatus, and scaling strategy. Pilot-scale development is justified only if the two central experiments succeed and the remaining gates can then be refined experimentally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种概念性设想：在可重复使用的长条单晶金属表面上，通过反复"生长-热离型-再生长"循环来制造大面积单晶石墨烯和六方氮化硼薄膜。作者并未演示集成工艺，而是通过两项关键实验（高温下快速无损伤离型、重复循环中可接受的薄膜生长）来决定该概念是否值得继续开发，并对晶体生长表面、层数控制、界面与气相化学、产物捕获、质量、能耗和规模等进行了前瞻性分析。
AI.motivation: 大面积单晶石墨烯和hBN的批量化制造仍受限于面积、产量和质量，传统批量生长与转移工艺难以突破这些瓶颈，因此需要探索全新的连续化生产范式。
AI.method: 提出在长条可复用单晶金属表面进行反复"生长-热离型-再生长"循环的滚动式制造概念；通过两个核心实验（热态无损伤离型、多循环生长可行性）作为早期决策门槛，并对生长表面、层数控制、界面/气相化学、产物捕获、质量、能源与规模进行系统分析，设置早期停止标准。
AI.result: 本文未演示集成工艺，仅提供概念性分析。作者识别出热离型可能成为速率限制步骤，单晶生长面积决定每周期产量；提出了决定概念去留的两项关键实验标准，并指出中试开发仅在两项实验成功且其余门槛可实验验证后才具有合理性。
AI.conclusion: 该滚动式"生长-热离型-再生长"概念尚处于早期探索阶段，石墨烯作为定量基线，hBN需要独立的M(111)晶面、产品厚度、设备和放大策略。只有在两项核心实验成功且剩余技术门槛可经实验精炼的前提下，才应推进中试规模开发。

title: Spin preservation in screw-symmetric molecules
summary: In electronic transport through long molecules, spin is expected to be preserved only when the dwell time is much shorter than the characteristic spin-mixing timescale $\hbar/Δ$, where $Δ$ is the magnitude of a spin-dependent potential, such as spin-orbit coupling. We show that, in molecules featuring discrete screw symmetry, spin preservation can be enhanced far beyond this timescale owing to strong spin separation in quasi-momentum. This spin fidelity in long molecules is consistent with chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS), suggesting spin-dependent transport in long, chiral molecules with amplified spin-splitting mechanisms. We provide analytical derivation of the enhanced spin preservation and test it on tight-binding models, which confirm that the effect gradually weakens when the screw symmetry is broken or changes from discrete to continuous. Furthermore, we perform transport simulations to show that a strong magnetoresistance trace of symmetry-protected spin fidelity emerges in a spin-valve setup with two magnetic leads, which we propose as an experimentally accessible signature.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有离散螺旋对称性的长分子中的自旋保持机制，发现自旋在远超过特征自旋混合时间尺度时仍能被保持，这归因于准动量空间中强烈的自旋分离，与手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）一致。作者提供了解析推导，并用紧束缚模型验证，并通过自旋阀装置模拟展示了可实验观测的磁阻特征。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为，长分子中的电子传输中，只有当停留时间远短于自旋混合时间尺度ℏ/Δ时自旋才能保持。但CISS实验表明长手性分子中自旋选择性传输可发生，因此需要解释自旋在长分子中如何超越这一限制被保持。
AI.method: 1）解析推导了离散螺旋对称性下增强的自旋保持机制；2）在紧束缚模型上进行数值测试，系统研究对称性破缺（从离散变为连续或打破螺旋对称）的影响；3）构建自旋阀装置（两个磁性电极）进行输运模拟，展示强磁阻特征。
AI.result: 研究发现离散螺旋对称性可显著增强长分子的自旋保持，远超ℏ/Δ时间尺度；当螺旋对称性被打破或从离散变为连续时，该效应逐渐减弱；自旋阀设置中呈现出强磁阻信号，作为可实验观测的CISS特征。
AI.conclusion: 离散螺旋对称性为长手性分子中的自旋保持提供了对称性保护机制，为CISS效应提供了理论基础，并提出了自旋阀磁阻测量作为实验验证途径。

title: The Effect of Geometry on Thermodynamic Response
summary: At the nano- and microscale, various patterns influence and shape thermal and optical response, making them essential for the survival of various biological species. In addition, controlling thermal radiation is vital for a broad range of applications, such as thermal management, spectroscopy, optoelectronics, and energy conversion technologies. For this reason, there is strong pressure to elucidate the physics of thermal radiation at the nanoscale. In this article, we provide evidence that complex nanoscale geometries affect thermal management, leading to an unusual thermal response in heat-capacity measurements as a function of temperature. Beyond identifying the structural constraints associated with this unusual thermodynamic response, the current study introduces the possibility of shaping the apparent heat-capacity response through geometry without necessarily altering the system's chemistry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了纳米尺度几何形状对热辐射和热管理的影响，发现复杂纳米结构会导致热容测量中出现异常的热响应，并提出通过几何设计而非化学改变来调控表观热容响应。
AI.motivation: 纳米和微米尺度的图案结构对热学和光学响应有重要影响，对生物物种生存至关重要，同时控制热辐射对热管理、光谱学、光电子学和能量转换等广泛应用至关重要，因此迫切需要阐明纳米尺度热辐射的物理机制。
AI.method: 通过实验和理论分析研究复杂纳米尺度几何结构对热管理的影响，在热容随温度变化的测量中观测异常热响应，并识别导致该异常热力学响应的结构约束条件。
AI.result: 提供了复杂纳米尺度几何结构影响热管理的证据，观测到热容测量中随温度变化的异常热响应，并确定了与此异常热力学响应相关的结构约束。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明可以通过几何形状来塑造表观热容响应，而无需改变系统的化学组成，为热管理调控提供了新的自由度。

title: Magnon-induced phononic Chern insulator
summary: High-frequency artificial phononic crystals offer a low-loss platform compatible with on-chip integration, yet realizing Chern phononic phases at GHz frequencies remains challenging. Here, we propose a magnon-induced phononic Chern insulator in a honeycomb phononic crystal hybridized with ferromagnetic islands at the hexagon centers. A circularly polarized Kittel mode couples to the surrounding phonons with a phase winding, which breaks time-reversal symmetry and opens a full Chern gap. In the large-detuning regime, this mechanism leads to an effective Haldane-type phononic model with magnon-induced complex hopping. By tuning the magnon-phonon interaction, the full hybrid system accesses Chern phases with tunable Chern numbers |C|=1 and |C|=2. The predicted gaps can exceed realistic phonon and magnon linewidths, enabling their observation in GHz acoustic devices. Our work establishes chiral magnon--phonon hybridization as a route to magnetically reconfigurable topological phononics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种由磁振子诱导的声子陈绝缘体，通过在六角声子晶体中心放置铁磁岛，利用圆偏振Kittel模式与周围声子的相位缠绕耦合，在GHz频率下打破时间反演对称性并打开完整的陈能隙，实现可调陈数|C|=1和|C|=2的拓扑声子相。
AI.motivation: 高频人造声子晶体为片上集成提供了低损耗平台，但在GHz频率下实现陈声子相仍然具有挑战性，需要新的机制来打破声子体系的时间反演对称性。
AI.method: 在蜂窝声子晶体的六边形中心放置铁磁岛，圆偏振Kittel模式与周围声子产生具有相位缠绕的耦合，打破时间反演对称性并打开完整陈能隙。在大失谐区域，该机制等效于具有磁振子诱导复跳跃的Haldane型声子模型。通过调节磁振子-声子相互作用，系统可进入陈数为1或2的拓扑相。
AI.result: 预言了声子能隙可超过实际声子和磁振子线宽，使GHz声学器件中的观测成为可能；系统可进入陈数|C|=1和|C|=2的可调拓扑相。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了手性磁振子-声子杂化作为实现磁可重构拓扑声子学的路线，为GHz频率下拓扑声子器件的实现提供了新途径。

title: A novel Grand-Potential Phase-Field Lattice-Boltzmann model for multi-phase solidification with convection
summary:
Melt convection plays a critical role in microstructure evolution during alloy solidification, yet accurately capturing its interaction with moving solid-liquid interfaces remains a significant computational challenge, particularly in multi-phase, multi-component systems. In this work, we develop a computational framework that couples a Grand-Potential phase-field model with the Lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) to simulate convection-driven solidification within a unified and thermodynamically consistent formulation. The proposed approach rigorously enforces no-slip conditions at evolving solid-liquid interfaces, while fluid transport is solved using the standard single-relaxation-time Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook collision operator. The framework provides an efficient and robust methodology for resolving the coupled evolution of interfaces, solute transport, and fluid flow.
  The versatility of the proposed framework is demonstrated through simulations of dendritic and eutectic solidification under natural convection. The results show that convection significantly modifies solute segregation, destabilizes growth fronts, and induces oscillatory growth modes in both systems. These examples illustrate the capability of the proposed method to capture complex flow-induced morphological instabilities and provide new insights into the mechanisms governing convection-driven microstructure evolution in alloy solidification.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个将Grand-Potential相场模型与格子玻尔兹曼方法（LBM）耦合的计算框架，用于模拟合金凝固过程中的对流驱动凝固，该框架在统一的热力学一致公式中严格实现了固液界面上的无滑移条件，并通过枝晶和共晶凝固的模拟展示了其对流动诱导形态不稳定性的捕捉能力。

title: Giant bulk photovoltaic effect driven by interfacial symmetry breaking in MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 heterostructures
summary: Van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures offer a versatile platform for engineering unconventional bulk photovoltaic (BPV) effect through interfacial symmetry breaking. However, the coexistence of multiple photophysical mechanisms, driven by structural complexity, spontaneous charge transfer, and strong interlayer coupling, often obscures the microscopic origin of the BPV response and hinders its rational optimization. Here, we demonstrate a pronounced BPV effect localized at the overlap region of a cross-bar MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 vdW heterostructure, where symmetry breaking induced by vertical stacking lifts the inversion center of MoS2. The orthogonal device geometry enables the independent probing of intralayer and interfacial photoresponse pathways, facilitating clear separation of competing mechanisms. Spontaneous interfacial charge transfer between MoS2 and Ta2NiSe5 further establishes a strong interlayer electronic coupling. By modulating the interlayer potential landscape through gate voltage and vertical electric fields, we achieve an optimized zero-bias photocurrent density of 247 A/cm2 and a BPV coefficient of 0.99 V-1. Supported by theoretical modelling, our results illustrate how minimalist device geometry can transform complex heterostructures into experimentally tractable platforms. This strategy paves the way for analyzing and optimizing interface-driven BPV effect, with implications for self-powered optoelectronics, broadband photodetection, and energy-harvesting nanodevices.

AI.tldr: 本文在MoS2/Ta2NiSe5交叉条形范德华异质结中展示了局域化的体光伏效应(BPV)，通过正交器件几何结构独立探测层内和界面光响应路径，分离竞争机制，并通过栅压和垂直电场调控层间势垒，实现了247 A/cm2的零偏压光电流密度和0.99 V-1的BPV系数。
AI.motivation: 范德华异质结虽可通过界面对称性破缺工程化非传统体光伏效应，但结构复杂性、自发电荷转移和强层间耦合导致多种光物理机制共存，掩盖了BPV响应的微观起源，阻碍了合理化优化。因此需要一种方法能够清晰分离并鉴别各机制的贡献。
AI.method: 采用交叉条形(cross-bar)MoS2/Ta2NiSe5范德华异质结构，利用正交器件几何独立探测层内与界面光响应路径，通过垂直堆叠引起的对称性破缺移除MoS2的反演中心；借助自发界面电荷转移建立强层间耦合，并通过栅压和垂直电场调控层间电势形态以优化BPV性能。
AI.result: 实现了零偏压光电流密度247 A/cm2和BPV系数0.99 V-1；实验结果表明BPV效应局域化于异质结重叠区域，并成功分离了层内和界面光响应贡献，理论模型支持了实验观察。
AI.conclusion: 极简器件几何结构可将复杂异质结构转化为实验上可操作的平台，为分析和优化界面驱动的BPV效应开辟了新途径，对自供电光电子、宽带光电探测和能量收集纳米器件具有重要启示。

title: Decoupled domain-texture switching from magnetic easy axis in kagome ferromagnet EuTi3Bi4
summary: Magnetic anisotropy defines the easy axis of a magnetic material and governs the spatial arrangement of its domains. To date, anisotropy engineering has focused on reorienting the easy axis or tuning the anisotropy energy, both of which demand substantial energy input. Here, we demonstrate that magnetic domain textures can be switched without reorienting the easy axis, as observed in a kagome ferromagnet EuTi3Bi4 crystal. Using low-temperature magnetic force microscopy, we observe that the preferred orientation of magnetic domains switches from the a-axis to the b-axis upon temperature variation, and that this switching can also be triggered by an out-of-plane magnetic-field reset. Magnetization measurements and density functional theory calculations confirm a robust c-axis easy magnetization, ruling out a conventional spin-reorientation transition. Instead, the texture switching is governed by the temperature dependence of the in-plane variation of the Magnetic anisotropy energy landscape, which arises from two competing interactions with different decay rates: single-ion anisotropy favors a-oriented spin components, while nearest-neighbor anisotropic exchange favors b-oriented ones. Furthermore, the critical switching temperature is substantially elevated in a mechanically exfoliated EuTi3Bi4 flake. Our findings establish that macroscopic magnetic textures can be effectively manipulated by tuning the competition between in-plane anisotropic interactions, without the energy cost of reorienting the easy axis.

AI.tldr: 本文在kagome铁磁体EuTi3Bi4晶体中展示了磁畴织构可以在不重定向易轴的情况下进行切换。通过低温磁力显微镜观察到磁畴优先取向随温度在a轴和b轴之间切换，也可通过面外磁场重置触发。磁化和DFT计算证实c轴易磁化方向保持稳健，排除了传统自旋重定向转变。织构切换由磁各向异性能量景观的面内变化的温度依赖性控制，源于两种竞争相互作用（单离子各向异性偏好a取向自旋，最近邻各向异性交换偏好b取向）。在机械剥离的薄片中，临界切换温度显著升高。
AI.motivation: 传统各向异性工程通过重定向易轴或调节各向异性能量来实现，但这两种方式都需要大量能量输入。作者希望探索一种更节能的方式，即在不改变易轴方向的前提下，仅通过调节面内各向异性相互作用的竞争来切换磁畴织构。
AI.method: 采用低温磁力显微镜直接观察磁畴织构随温度的变化；结合磁化测量和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，确认c轴易磁化方向不变；通过分析单离子各向异性与最近邻各向异性交换两种竞争的相互作用及其不同衰减率，解释了面内各向异性能量景观的温度依赖性；并对比机械剥离薄片与块体晶体的临界切换温度。
AI.result: 成功观察到磁畴优先取向在a轴和b轴之间的切换，且c轴易磁化方向保持稳定；织构切换由面内各向异性能量景观的温度依赖变化驱动；机械剥离的EuTi3Bi4薄片显示出显著升高的临界切换温度。

title: Band offsets and electronic structure at $α$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions
summary: Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunction materials are emerging as promising candidates for deep-ultraviolet optoelectronics. Here, the band offsets at the $α$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions are investigated through hybrid functional calculations. Explicit, realistic slab models that satisfy electron counting rules are constructed for the heterojunctions. Our calculations demonstrate that a type-II staggered band alignment forms at the $α$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions, where both the valence and conduction band edges of $α$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ are higher than those of $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$. Strain effects on the band alignment are also discussed. Spatially resolved local density of states maps are presented, clearly revealing the interfacial electronic structures. These results provide valuable insights into the physical properties of Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions, offering guidance for future device design efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过杂化泛函计算系统研究了α/β-Ga₂O₃和κ/β-Ga₂O₃相异质结的能带排列，构建了满足电子计数规则的显式、真实的平板模型。计算表明两种相异质结均形成type-II交错能带排列，α-Ga₂O₃和κ-Ga₂O₃的价带和导带边缘均高于β-Ga₂O₃，并讨论了应变效应对能带排列的影响，通过空间分辨局域态密度图清晰展示了界面电子结构。

AI.result: α/β-Ga₂O₃和κ/β-Ga₂O₃相异质结均形成type-II交错能带排列，α-Ga₂O₃和κ-Ga₂O₃的价带和导带边缘均高于β-Ga₂O₃。应变对能带排列有影响，空间分辨局域态密度图清晰揭示了界面电子结构。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为Ga₂O₃相异质结的物理性质提供了有价值的见解，为未来器件设计提供了指导。

title: Terahertz anomalous Hall effect in magnetic Weyl semimetal Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$
summary: Time-reversal-symmetry-broken Weyl semimetals are known to have at least two nodes in their electronic band structure, separated in momentum space and acting as sources and sinks of Berry curvature. This gives rise to a transverse Hall conductivity, known as the anomalous Hall effect (AHE), which, in the simplest two-node picture, is proportional to the momentum-space separation between the nodes in the zero frequency limit. In the recently discovered Weyl semimetal $\mathrm{Co_3Sn_2S_2}$, a giant AHE has been observed. However, experimental investigations in the low-energy regime, which directly probe quasiparticle excitations near the Weyl nodes, remain limited. Here, we present a systematic study of the intrinsic low-energy gyrotropic optical response of $\mathrm{Co_3Sn_2S_2}$ using terahertz spectroscopy combined with semianalytical calculations based on a physically intuitive effective model. Our results provide a robust and transparent explanation of the observed magnetooptical phenomena in terms of intrinsic gyrotropy arising from momentum-space separation of the Weyl nodes. Furthermore, quantitative comparison between experiment and theory places stringent constraints on the material parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文使用太赫兹光谱结合半解析有效模型，系统研究了Weyl半金属Co₃Sn₂S₂的低能旋光（gyrotropic）光学响应，揭示了其由动量空间中Weyl节点分离所导致的内在旋光性，并通过实验与理论的定量对比严格约束了材料参数。
AI.motivation: Co₃Sn₂S₂中已观测到巨大的反常霍尔效应（AHE），但直接探测Weyl节点附近准粒子激发的低能实验研究仍然有限，缺乏对低能旋光响应的系统理解。
AI.method: 采用太赫兹光谱实验测量Co₃Sn₂S₂的低能旋光光学响应，并结合基于物理直觉构建的有效模型进行半解析计算，将实验结果与理论计算进行定量比较。
AI.result: 实验结果能够以Weyl节点动量空间分离引起的内在旋光性得到稳健而清晰的解释，并对材料参数施加了严格的定量约束。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解Co₃Sn₂S₂中低能磁光现象提供了清晰的理论框架，证明了内在旋光效应来源于Weyl节点的动量空间分离，并为材料参数确定提供了有效的实验-理论联合约束手段。

title: Band's Geometry Origin of Quantum Spin Transport Phenomena
summary: We develop a geometric description of spin-dependent transport based on the local geometric structure of electronic bands and the Fermi surfaces. For quasi-two-dimensional systems, we show that hyperbolic regions of constant-energy surfaces generate a geometrical contribution to the Fermi velocity that couples naturally to electron spin and produces a spin-current response. We further show that, in the presence of time-reversal symmetry, the algebra of spin operators can be related to the exterior algebra of the band's tangent space, providing an additional geometric interpretation of spin in momentum space. This framework motivates a symplectic description of spin-separated transport on Fermi surfaces and its extension to three-dimensional band manifolds through contact geometry. Our results establish a direct connection between Fermi-surface geometry and intrinsic spin transport.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一种基于电子能带和费米面局部几何结构的自旋相关输运的几何描述。对于准二维系统，研究显示等能面的双曲区域会对照费米速度产生几何贡献，该贡献自然耦合电子自旋并产生自旋流响应。在时间反演对称存在的情况下，自旋算符的代数可与能带切空间的外代数相关联，为动量空间中的自旋提供额外的几何解释。该框架启发了费米面上自旋分离输运的辛描述及其通过接触几何向三维能带流形的扩展。
AI.motivation: 传统自旋输运理论多依赖哈密顿量的具体形式，缺乏对自旋相关输运过程的几何直观理解。作者旨在建立费米面几何结构与固有自旋输运之间的直接联系，提供统一的几何框架来理解和预测自旋相关输运现象。
AI.method: 1) 基于电子能带和费米面的局部几何结构（等能面曲率特征）建立自旋相关输运的几何描述；2) 对准二维系统，识别等能面的双曲区域作为产生几何费米速度贡献的关键结构；3) 利用时间反演对称性将自旋算符代数映射到能带切空间的外代数；4) 引入辛几何（symplectic）描述费米面上的自旋分离输运；5) 通过接触几何（contact geometry）将框架扩展至三维能带流形。
